    "(Tutorial_OpenMM_Add_plane_harmonic_restraint)=\n",
    "# Add plane harmonic restraint\n",
    "\n",
    "*Restraining atoms to lie on a 2D plane with harmonic potential wells in OpenMM.*\n",
    "\n",
    "The function {func}`molsysmt.third_party.openmm.forces.add_plane_harmonic_restraint` tethers selected atoms to a defined planar geometry.\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{versionadded} 1.0.0\n",
    ":::\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{admonition} API documentation\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "Follow this link for a detailed description of the input arguments, raised errors, and returned objects: {func}`molsysmt.third_party.openmm.forces.add_plane_harmonic_restraint`.\n",
    ":::\n"
   ]

    "## Basic usage\n",
    "\n",
    "Let's add a planar harmonic restraint:"
   ]

    "import molsysmt as msm\n",
    "\n",
    "molsys = msm.convert(msm.systems['Trp-Cage']['1l2y.h5msm'], to_form='molsysmt.MolSys')\n",
    "force = msm.third_party.openmm.forces.add_plane_harmonic_restraint(molsys, point='[0,0,0] nm', normal_vector=(0,0,1), selection=[0], force_constant='500 kJ/(mol*nm**2)', return_force=True)\n",
    "print('Plane harmonic restraint created:', type(force))"
